purpose: Hard upper bounds preventing synthetic data generator from creating trivial, deterministic, or single-shortcut targets.

nearest_origin_cluster_rate.rationale: Prevents distance baseline from trivially dominating the ML ranker.

terminal_mule_district_match_rate.rationale: Ensures terminal mule branch district is informative but never deterministic.

dominant_account_district_match_rate.rationale: Prevents downstream laundering account majority from completely collapsing the target.

maximum_single_cluster_target_share.rationale: Ensures full utilization across all 60 clusters and prevents geographic mode collapse.

fraud_type_to_single_cluster_concentrati.rationale: Guarantees no fraud modus operandi maps directly to a specific cluster.

archetype_to_single_cluster_concentratio.rationale: Ensures even latent operational archetypes sample across multiple corridors.

enforcement_rule: Every generated dataset must strictly respect all 6 hard ceilings. A violation of any single ceiling constitutes immediate generation invalidation.
